name: Rahul Ostwal
headline: Software Engineer | Voice and Text AI Agents | Developer SDKs
summary: Software engineer with 11+ years of experience, including 8+ years building contact-center AI at Cisco. Since September 2025, designed and built AI Agent Platform 2.0 from scratch across text, cascade voice and native realtime speech. Work in Python, TypeScript and Java, with a focus on concurrency, recovery and developer APIs. Built livekit-continuity, a set of LiveKit Agents POCs for durable work, channel continuity and specialist delegation.

letter.subject: Application for Software Engineer Agents
paragraphs: I am applying for the Software Engineer, Agents role. I bring 11+ years of software engineering experience, including contact-center AI at Cisco since 2018. Since September 2025, I have designed and built Cisco's AI Agent Platform 2.0 from scratch, working on stateful agents, voice and text interactions, and the APIs other developers use to integrate them.

The platform supports text, cascade voice and native realtime integrations with OpenAI, Gemini and Amazon Nova Sonic. My work includes bounded actor scheduling, context-preserving agent handoffs and epoch fencing so late output cannot take over a newer interaction. Python execution components separate cancellation from physical work completion. I also defined the shared protobuf contract and built Java transport SDKs and Python/TypeScript protocol helpers, with examples and integration guidance.

I built livekit-continuity to explore these reliability problems directly with LiveKit Agents. Its Python and TypeScript components cover durable accepted work, continuity across voice, browser text and simulated SMS, and validated specialist delegation. PostgreSQL-backed state, explicit human confirmation and bounded recovery tests make the failure boundaries inspectable. These are local proofs of concept with documented limits.

Earlier, I architected Topic Analytics orchestration for 300K+ recordings per day and led tracing improvements that reduced incident MTTR from 90 to 20 minutes. I would bring that operational perspective to your team's work on durable workflows and text channels, together with a focus on simple Python and TypeScript APIs whose cancellation and recovery behaviour developers can understand.

I am based in Sambhajinagar, India, and am applying only for remote work from India. I would welcome confirmation that this opening can support that arrangement, and the opportunity to discuss the project and my experience.
